query: SELECT region, gender, population_count, region_total, percentage FROM (SELECT hl.region, hp.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) AS population_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no)) OVER (PARTITION BY hl.region ) AS region_total, ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no) * 100.0) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id, hp.dependent_seq_no)) OVER (PARTITION BY hl.region ), 2) AS percentage FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id WHERE hp.is_in_population = true AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala) AND hl.region IS NOT NULL AND Trim( hl.region ) != '' GROUP BY hl.region, hp.gender) t ORDER BY percentage ASC, region, gender LIMIT 1200
